example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইটা পড়লে মনে হয় বটতলার উপন্যাসের মতো সস্তা গল্প।
তার লেখা বইগুলো বটতলার উপন্যাসের মানের।
example_sentences_in_english: This book feels like a cheap story from a Bat-tola novel.
His written books are of the quality of Bat-tola novels.
history: Refers to the Bat-tola area in 19th-century Kolkata (Calcutta) where inexpensive, sensational pamphlets, novels, and cheap literature were printed and sold under banyan trees or in local presses, often catering to mass audiences with melodramatic content.
note: The term evokes the historical context of early Bengali print culture and urban literary markets.
